calls.title: GrowthBook and MediaHub
calls.summary: GrowthBook’s Daniel Wathne (sales) and Logan Bates (solutions engineering) discussed their experimentation platform with MediaHub’s Anas Ahmed, who manages media experiments. Key pain points included reliance on ad hoc R/Python scripts, a rigid existing platform, and data integration challenges. Next steps: Anas will share documentation and a demo recording with his head of analytics, James, and Daniel will follow up via email.
